notes.title: Five Night's At Stickman: Congratulations and BIG NEWS!
notes.notes: [p]Hello there![/p][p][/p][p]I have 4 points to talk about today so let's get into it,[/p][p][/p][h1]1 - NEW GAME ANNOUNCEMENT[/h1][p][/p][p]While it is still far away, I can officially give you the title;[/p][p][/p][p]Crosspoint: The Bio-Rage Event, will be the next game on Relevation Studios's library,[/p][p][/p][p]It will offer these things:[/p][olist][*][p]Game set in the same universe as Biorage but NOT a traditional sequel[/p][/*][*][p]Expand the Biorage lore significantly via major lore bits[/p][/*][*][p]Solve issues that Biorage had, so no more chapters with independent exe's for example.[/p][/*][*][p]Add new features like ragdoll, better weapons, subtitles, no more corridor shooting & more![/p][/*][*][p]Enhance the game Biorage if you were to replay it[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]It is part of a bigger universe I'm trying to create![/p][p][/p][h1]2 - END OF LAUNCH SALE[/h1][p][/p][p]The Five Night's At Stickman launch and launch sale is now done. It's been the best launch yet, [/p][p][/p][p]and places 2ND in total sales of my games. (1st being cucumber champion, 3rd being Biorage)[/p][p][/p][p]Although Biorage GOT CLOSE to overtaking FNAS when it joined the sale, it never did.[/p][p][/p][h1]3 - CONGRATULATIONS[/h1][p][/p][p]BIg W for the youtuber [url="https://www.youtube.com/@XPOLKERX_YT/videos"]XPOLKERX_YT[/url][b] [/b]for completing FNAS 20/20/20/20 mode![/p][p][/p][p]Go show them some love![/p][p][/p][h1]4 - What about Project F.R.A.G.?[/h1][p][/p][p]For the people following these tidbits, Project F.R.A.G. was sorta announced a while ago,[/p][p][/p][p]It was and is a remastered project for remastering a bunch of ancient game thingies. From shooters to just liminal space showcases etc.[/p][p][/p][p]But..., it is more work than I thought and crosspoint is taking lead now![/p][p][/p][p]It WILL be released at some point in the future![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for reading and see you next time.[/p]

notes.title: The ART of Five Nights At Stickman
notes.notes: [h1]THE ART:[/h1][p][/p][h1]UI:[/h1][p][/p][p]The UI is ofcourse very much inspired by FNAF 1,[/p][p]The visual assets of the camera button, the doors, the power buttons.[/p][p]I'd say the 2 biggest differences is the way the office looks and the red flashing lights during gameplay.[/p][p][/p][h1]AUDIO:[/h1][p][/p][p]The audio design is minimalistic, but haunting enough to shiver thy timbers.[/p][p][/p][p]It's hard to compare it to FNAF 1, as nearly all sounds are different in approach.[/p][p][/p][h1]CAMERA LOCATIONS & STICKMEN:[/h1][p][/p][p]Ofcourse the BIG thing that sets it a little apart.[/p][p][/p][p]We have the inky art at each camera location, and the bright coloured stickmen in those locatrions.[/p][p][/p][p]This makes the colour difference very....alien? notes.title: From Biorage to Stickman
notes.notes: [h1]HOW DID WE GET HERE?[/h1][p][/p][p]Biorage was an old school FPS, Five Nights At Stickman is a satirical FNAF fangame.[/p][p][/p][p]My actual original plans predate the cancelled BitBox title![/p][p][/p][p]I was planning on sticking to first person shooters, however, after messing around with a potential new and different FPS, I kinda felt meh about it.[/p][p][/p][p]Then came BitBox which did have an FPS as one of it's minigames. But in general bitbox was a major step in a different direction.[/p][p][/p][p]Then came FNAS, a wild idea I had in my head out of nowhere, and I kinda....loved it. SImple, but fun, really fun to make personally for me![/p][p][/p][p]I WILL likely do FPS again in the future, but just not now.[/p]

notes.title: Surviving Five Nights At Stickman, A beginner's guide
notes.notes: [p]Hello there![/p][p][/p][p]A quick little guide for you to enjoy as we lead up to the release of FNAS.[/p][p][/p][h1]ANIMATRONICS[/h1][p][/p][p]There's 4 animatronics.[/p][p][/p][p]Eclipse: A calm animatronic that strikes only when it's absolutely certain you are not looking...[/p][p][/p][p]Omega: Keeps to the left, but ignore him for too long.....and you'll be a stickman soon enough[/p][p][/p][p]Silver: This blueish hunk a chunk likes to be ethereal on the cameras, incomprehensible even, but he is visible enough that you can see where he lies. He loves the right side.[/p][p][/p][p]Flapper: They are in flapper"s den. When you are not looking, or when you are, he will slowly move and at the right time, she will kill you and you'll be another victim in it's den.[/p][p][/p][h1]MECHANICS[/h1][p][/p][p]Survive 5 nights, maybe a 6th, definitly a 7th.[/p][p][/p][p]You have limited power, 2 doors and a camera system to survive.[/p][p][/p][p]Let's just say the last person that ran out of power......has had a fate worse than eternal suffering....[/p]

notes.title: Stickman Preview: Silver
notes.notes: [p]Today, as part of our daily posts until launch, we'll talk about one stickman: Silver![/p][p][/p][p]Silver is a bright cyan-colored figure, resembling a rudimentary human form. [/p][p][/p][p]It has a simple, rounded head with two small, circular eyes.[/p][p][/p][p]The body is a single, vertical line, from which extend two curved arms and two slightly diverging legs, creating a simplistic yet recognizable humanoid shape.[/p][p][/p][p]Silver is what one would call.....a masterpiece of design and production.[/p][p][/p][p]It took stickman's bistro many years to design Silver.[/p][p][/p][p]But after hard work, sweat, [strike]murders[/strike], blood and tears, Silver was finally created![/p][p][/p][p]Such a cute little stickman!, So CUTE he will rip your ligments kindly![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: FNAS: Fan Theories
notes.notes:
[p]Today we explore 3 fan theories![/p][p][/p][h3][b]1. The Omelette Theory[/b][/h3][p][b]Omega isn't named after the Greek letter—he's named after an omelette.[/b]
This theory claims that [i]Stickman's Bistro[/i] was originally a breakfast-themed game, and Omega was once a chef bot named [b]Exotic Butter Omega[/b]. Fans point to his orange eyes (obviously yolk-colored), the sizzling sound in the kitchen cam, and a newspaper clipping that allegedly says [b]"Omelette Incident Shuts Down Bistro."[/b] Some even claim if you click the microwave 6 times at 3:14 AM, a robotic voice says [i]“Whisk me away.”[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]2. The Eclipse Reversal[/b][/h3][p][b]Eclipse is actually the daytime version of the villain, not the nighttime one.[/b]
This theory argues Eclipse is a metaphorical red herring: instead of being scary because she represents darkness, she’s the real threat [i]because she hides in plain daylight.[/i] The sunbeams on Cam 5 are said to “flicker” when she moves, and her jump scare triggers [i]only[/i] if you check the outdoor camera during sunrise. This somehow means [i]she’s the cause of the bistro's “perpetual brunch time.”[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]3. The Silver Spoon Theory[/b][/h3][p][b]Silver is the true owner of the bistro and orchestrated the whole thing because of class resentment.[/b]
Some players noticed Silver has a [i]different look[/i] compared to the others and believe he was originally a customer who [i]inherited the bistro through obscure stickman law.[/i] Bitter about being mocked by Flapper for “ordering sparkling water without irony,” he digitized everyone’s consciousness in revenge.[/p][p][/p][p]But that's just a theory......A GAMEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEE THEOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOORY[/p]

notes.title: What game engines have I used?
notes.notes: [p]Hello there, back again with a daily post.[/p][p][/p][p]This time, about the engines I've used and my experience with them.[/p][p][/p][p]Since I do have a tendency to change engines constantly (my bad)[/p][p][/p][p]A short but sweet post![/p][p][/p][p](Don't forget to check out my new game coming out august 1st, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3831510/Five_Nights_At_Stickman/"]Five Nights At Stickman[/url])[/p][p][/p][p][b]Cucumber Champion[/b], made with [b]UNITY[/b]. [/p][p][/p][p]-- I like unity, and can see myself working with it more in the future.[/p][p]-- Although, it was also a learning curve. But it was fun enough to make a game with.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Biorage[/b], made with [b]First Person Shooter Creator Black Ice Advanced Mod[/b][/p][p][/p][p]-- An easier engine ofcourse, although the easier they come, the more annoying they can be.[/p][p]-- It had MAJOR limitations. It was HELL sometimes to make levels. [/p][p]-- They worked fine in the engine, and then broke in the exported game.[/p][p]-- The BIMA mod did introduce cool overhauls. But the core OLD engine was still in there.[/p][p]-- For example, if the export went beyond 2GB of memory? It broke.[/p][p]-- This SEVERELY limited my levels and my graphics. [/p][p]-- Hence why Biorage is very audio focused, and very "keep moving" focused.[/p][p]-- It's a miracle that Biorage functions the way it does! [/p][p]-- All this talk, but I still had a lot of fun (likely won't make a new game with the engine tho..)[/p][p][/p][p]The cancelled game, [b]BitBox[/b], made with [b]Rosebud AI[/b][/p][p][/p][p]-- Yeah....this was an experiment. An AI can make games?!....Well no....[/p][p]-- Rosebud was more a coding tool, that creates basic enviroments with JAVA and THREE.[/p][p]-- Pretty cool, pretty limiting, although the stuff I made had some cool tones to it.[/p][p]-- Was it difficult? I'd say it was annoying.[/p][p]-- It was cool to DO, don't get me wrong, quite fascinating even.[/p][p]-- but....thousands of prompts for a single game felt..cheap, and the results weren't even that great;[/p][p]-- TLDR, AI for game creation is....controversial, Rosebud......is just kinda trash. (but still cool)[/p][p]-- TLDR2, BitBox was still quite fun, but the ENGINE was....meh. (too expensive as well)[/p][p][/p][p][b]Five Nights At Stickman[/b], made with [b]GDEVELOP5[/b][/p][p][/p][p]-- Nothing bad too say, a visual editor was a nice fresh thing. It challenged me again like unity.[/p][p]-- it was really fun to use. The downside being GDEVELOP costs MONEY to export games commercially.[/p][p]-- Other than that, it's actually a really nice engine. Very UI friendly. (likely because it's also for mobile)[/p][p]-- Had some errors exporting, quickly fixed.[/p][p][/p][h1]WHAT'S NEXT[/h1][p][/p][p]Well, GDEVELOP might be a contender for another game. [/p][p][/p][p]There's always the easier engines, but the downsides are sometimes major. [/p][p][/p][p]Let's take functions, you want to do something specific in unity? You can likely do so.[/p][p][/p][p]In easy engines? Not really, you'd need to custom overwrite so many things. (I did this a lot with biorage)[/p][p][/p][p]However does that mean I don't wanna try? Well no, Gameguru and Gameguru max for example look decent enough to give a chance. But I do not want a biorage repeat ofcourse.[/p][p][/p][p]Yapping, yapping, yapping, I'm done[/p]

notes.title: The Past, Present & The Future
notes.notes: [p]Hello there![/p][p][/p][p]Five Nights At Stickman is coming out soon, and as always I love to chat daily about random stuff.[/p][p][/p][p]So I have a few points, I want to talk about Relevation Studios, The past, present & future.[/p][p][/p][p]I don't think anyone will read this, but I just love to chat..[/p][p][/p][h1]RELEVATION STUDIOS[/h1][p][/p][p]I'm a single entity studio. Atlhough my first game was made with multiple people (which led it to it's ultimate demise)[/p][p][/p][p]I love to make short, sweet, cheap games. I have too many ideas to be spending years on a single project.[/p][p][/p][p]These ideas range from more satirical like Five Nights At Stickman to more serious like Biorage.[/p][p][/p][p]I'm not a "good" dev, I'll be honest. but I LOVE creating games and universes. [/p][p][/p][p]Biorage, or FNAS, or even the cancelled bitbox all have things I came up with and wanted to explore. [/p][p][/p][h1]THE PAST[/h1][p][/p][p]I've been making games for a year and half now. Not that long at all. [/p][p][/p][p]Let's look at the previous games,[/p][p][/p][p][b]Cucumber Champion[/b], delisted now sadly, but I do love the premise. [/p][p]-- If I'd made it today, it would likely be longer and solo made ofcourse (instead of multiple people). [/p][p]-- IN CASE you did not know yet, I did not wanted it to be delisted, but due to a fall out with the group that made this, it's a bit weird to keep it up. [/p][p]-- (imagine if it made a million suddenly, I have nearly no way to contact the old group)[/p][p][/p][p][b]Biorage[/b], I like this game. I like the over the top lore. I wish it would've performed better BUT I'm proud of what I put out.[/p][p]-- It's not "old" yet, as it can out a few months ago, but it was a bigger project. It litterally had 1 voiceactor (me) and tons of filters, voice changers etc to create the story.[/p][p]-- It was SO much fun to do. Although I did go a little overboard with the story as I had to make a steam post explaining it and a youtube video.[/p][p]-- If I could, I would change some stuff now, polish some more, add some more debris and extras in the levels and change some minor voice acting. However, on the other hand, I kinda....like it? Like it's just the way it is now.[/p][p][/p][p][b]BitBox[/b], the cancelled game, I liked it, although it has many tech issues with the steam testers so I just binned it. You can check out yesterdays post for more info on it[/p][p][/p][h1]THE PRESENT[/h1][p][/p][p][b]Five Nights At Stickman[/b] is yet another title that I thought about....REALLY thought about and had fun with. It's fun, I like it. It even has 4 voicecalls like FNAF1 to enhance the lore.[/p][p]But don't worry, it's not like current FNAF lore crazy. (although that would be fun). [/p][p]It's minimalistic but I'm proud of it. At first I was like, how will I make stickmen "3D", on an inky background. But then I was like....it would be funny if it's just over the top plackered on it. Enough coherency to work, but enough crazyness to be funny. [/p][p]The endings reveal some SHOCKING things (you will be shocked,...maybe...potentially)[/p][p][/p][h1]THE FUTURE[/h1][p][/p][p]Well, I'll continue to make tinier games. ALTHOUGH I'm not developing right now. [/p][p][/p][p]There ARE many ideas in my head. But In real life, I'm looking for a job right now, and things might get busy for a while.[/p][p][/p][p]Can I give you any ideas? I'll give you 1.[/p][p][/p][p]There are plans for a remastered bundled project. This project would contain A LOT of mini things from the early 2000"s. Remastered with graphical and gameplay overhauls.[/p][p][/p][p]Sounds a litte...confusing I know, like what games etc. But I've already been given some permission so it's looking to be exciting![/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned, although it might take a while.[/p][p][/p][p]So much text.....I AIN'T rereading all that[/p]

notes.title: The cancelled game: BitBox
notes.notes: [h1]What WAS BitBox?[/h1][p][/p][p]BitBox was originally supposed to be the game that releases august 1st. [/p][p][/p][p]But what IS BitBox? BitBox was a 15 minigame collection, it had racing, horror, stories, survival etc.[/p][p][/p][p]Sadly, after technical issues with the Steam testers, and some installscript issues, the game got cancelled.[/p][p][/p][p]Kinda sad as it was an entire game ofcourse. But alas. This led me to FNAS. [/p][p][/p][h1]Is it lost media?[/h1][p][/p][p]I'm afraid so. Perhaps one day I can put it on itch.io, but the technical issuess might persist.[/p][p][/p][p]I CAN give you 2 things.[/p][p][/p][p]The logo (as seen in this post)[/p][p][/p][p]The descriptions of the minigames: [/p][p][/p][h3]🎮 Featured Minigames:[/h3][p][b]Demon Slayer[/b] – A wave-based arena shooter where enemy spawns are randomized. Rack up high scores and survive the onslaught.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Spike Race[/b] – Race against AI in fast-paced, procedurally generated environments—complete with unexpected random events like rain... or giraffes.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Lunar Watcher[/b] – A mysterious, story-driven exploration on the moon. Collect anomalies and uncover fragments of lore... but be warned—[b]you’re not alone[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Meltdown[/b] – You're trapped in a submarine with an unstable reactor. Keep things under control and chat with crewmates—if you can.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Dragon Boss Fight[/b] – Face off against [b]three dragons[/b], each with randomly chosen attacks. Collect lore fragments and try to escape before everything crumbles around you.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Gardening[/b] – Harvest fruits to gain strange abilities like high jumps, speed boosts, shrinking, first-person view... and possibly encounter some [i]very determined snails[/i].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Case Opener[/b] – Open loot cases packed with weapons across four rarity tiers. notes.title: Five Nights, Zero Chill.
notes.notes: [h1]What exactly are the stickmen up to?[/h1][p][/p][p]Well well well, we have 4 stickmen.[/p][p][/p][olist][*][p][b]Eclipse[/b], this googly boogly has long tentacle like structure, it's calm most of the time, but when he gets mad......you wish you were dead.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Omega[/b], this box of a stickman is a bit quirky at times, it likes the left side a lot...it's not shy from cameras and will sometimes try to pose or show off his BOXY structure. [/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Silver[/b], this blue weirdo has floating eyes, nobody really knows why or how, he's also a bit goofy at times but more serious compared to his other stickmen.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p] [b]Flapper[/b], he be flapping[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p] [b][i][u]"REDACTED: REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED[/u][/i][/b][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Phone call man[/b], he be calling you every night, giving you neat tips and threatening you kindly.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]You[/b], you are someone with a past, you are someone familiar, yet what you seek only lies at the end of your journey.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h1]Meet the office[/h1][p][/p][p]The gameplay is classic FNAF1.[/p][p][/p][p]You have 2 doors, limited power, some lights to shine if a stickman is at the door, many cameras.[/p][p][/p][p]You have to survive.
